caption.en: Images of the management of a mucosal injury type 1 and evolution to a mucosal injury type 2 when left untreated (different patients) showing: a a mucosal injury type 1 viewed in the tunnel (delineated by a dotted line); b the same injury viewed from the esophageal lumen (delineated by a dotted line) a few seconds after the injury occurred; c the onset of surrounding erythema 20 minutes after the injury occurred; d a through-the-scope clip placed to treat the mucosal injury; e the final appearance after closure; f a type 2 mucosal injury that evolved over 48 hours from an unrecognized type 1 mucosal injury.
